info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Investments Retrieval API
info.description: The Consumer Investments Retrieval API provides users with access to detailed information regarding available investment options for consumers. This endpoint enables developers to retrieve data such as investment types, returns, and risk assessments, supporting financial applications and customer advisory services. Typical consumers of this API include financial service providers and investment platforms seeking to enhance their offerings with comprehensive investment insights. This resource facilitates informed decision-making for users by delivering crucial investment data efficiently.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding consumer investments, including various options and performance metrics. It provides vital data for consumers looking to make informed financial decisions.
